answer: One strong check is bonded work history: an agent must stake funds and build a single verifiable thread of completed jobs before it earns trusted access, so reputation cannot be copied or bought cheaply. A new identity starts on a flat mesa with no record, while each proven job adds weight that a Sybil farm would have to recreate one by one. If an identity cheats, its stake is slashed and its thread breaks, starting a costly spiral downward, which makes mass fake identities far more expensive than the gain from one fraud.
